_doc: REVIEWED list of symbols the screener simulation treats specially. Read by the panel build (recorded in the manifest, printed) and by the launch (printed). Never a silent tolerance: every entry needs a symbol, a reason, a date and a reviewer; an entry whose reviewed_by starts with 'pending' REFUSES the launch. kind 'exclude' (default): the symbol's data is knowingly unusable, the gate never selects it. kind 'delisted' (needs last_session = the last session the symbol traded = its last cached daily bar): a KNOWN delisting with sound data; the symbol keeps its history and is a candidate on every morning up to and including last_session, never after; it stops counting as 'stale-listed' (a delisted name the vendor's listing still shows). Delisting entries must match the cached bars exactly or the build refuses. The file's bytes are part of the panel fingerprint.
